# qrcode-generator 2.0.4

Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator

Vendored from the npm package `qrcode-generator@2.0.4`, `dist/qrcode.mjs`. Renamed to `qrcode.js` for the static local server; code and the MIT license notice in the source header are retained. Used to generate UUID-only QR labels with error correction M and a four-module quiet zone.
